mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the prior 3 months signals an accommodative monetary policy stance that reduces equity discount rates, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 4.0% in a 3-month window, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 4.0% in a 3-month window, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in consumer credit (RSAFS) and industrial production (INDPRO) signals a broad-based economic slowdown that triggers equity sell-offs, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both RSAFS and INDPRO decline, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During high consumer credit growth periods (RSAFS YoY > 1.5%), credit expansion fuels consumption and corporate profits, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are not significantly positive (t-test p>0.05) when RSAFS YoY growth exceeds 1.5%, or effect is absent in >30% of such periods.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in industrial production (INDPRO) over the prior 3 months indicates robust manufacturing activity that supports corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO increases over the prior 3 months, or Rank IC falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: When year-over-year CPI growth exceeds 3.0%, it signals accelerating inflation that prompts aggressive monetary tightening, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY growth exceeds 3.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.02 over 2-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in the federal funds rate and decline in unemployment rate signals an overheating economy that triggers aggressive monetary tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS rises and UNRATE falls, or Rank IC for interaction term falls below 0.02 over 3-year rolling windows.

mechanism_narrative: During manufacturing contraction periods (INDPRO below 100 index), industrial slowdown signals weakening economic activity that drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are not significantly negative (t-test p>0.05) when INDPRO is below 100, or effect is absent in >30% of such periods.
